items.title: Pragmatic solutions key for global economic progress
items.description: Shenzhen, in South China's Guangdong province, is a model city of Chinese modernization and one of the most remarkable successes in urban development. Designated as one of China's first special economic zones in 1980, this once-small frontier town has become a global hub for advanced manufacturing, technological innovation and international economic exchange. Its economic, technological, social and ecological achievements reflect the interaction of geographic advantages, institutional innovation, human capital and technological progress. Understanding these mechanisms offers valuable lessons for the Global South, and the wider international community.
